name: Agent & Orchestration
description: The central CAD agent driving the build123d observe-edit loop (brief, coder triage/routing, codegen, run/inspect/render, gemma visual critique, edit), plus Onshape STEP upload and the CLI/Telegram command surface.

name: Learning & Retrieval
description: The learning loop that retrieves semantically-similar few-shot build123d examples via nomic-embed and stores/retrieves fail-to-fix lessons, with a SHA-keyed embedding cache and word-overlap fallback.

name: Domain Geometry Helpers
description: Deterministic build123d geometry factories (structural_section beams, involute spur_gear, hex_bolt) plus shared thread-pitch conventions, imported and trusted directly by the agent without visual critique.

name: Geometry Runners & Tooling
description: Standalone subprocess runners the agent shells out to per loop iteration: step (build123d source to STEP), inspect (geometry validation), and render (STEP to two-panel critic PNG).

name: Evaluation & Benchmarks
description: The text-to-CAD benchmark harness that runs each spec through cad_agent_v4 as a subprocess and scores the derived STEP geometry, driven by the 10-spec benchmark suite.

name: Reference & Capability Data
description: Read-only context for codegen: build123d capability notes (extrude-cut, fillet/chamfer, mirror, threads) and legacy Onshape FeatureScript example and learned snippets carried over from the v1 pipeline.

name: Documentation
description: Top-level project documentation for CAD Agent v4.2: the PROJECT design doc, the operator-facing SKILL guide, and the BUILDS verification checklist.
